Equal masses of cyclic bands make every label cell have mass k^(-n), and conditioning an invariant product measure on a symbolic orbit is invariant. Each coordinate marginal remains ν because ψ^n simultaneously increments every label. G^n is componentwise h, proving all exponents equal χ/n via Birkhoff. G^(kn) leaves each cell invariant, and product entropy additivity plus the cyclic factor entropy identity give h_{η_C}(G)=h_ν(h)=χ by the expanding-interval entropy formula. The short-period probability bound follows by a union bound over prime-index periods. Exhaustive exact checks covered 33 small pairs and 36,490 states; finite checks do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source constructs many coexisting chaotic trapping components but its total-count formula conceals the asymmetry of which components stationary initial data select and whether their instability depends on component size. The combined exact classification answers both natural dynamical questions: each component has computable selection weight and length, short components can be exponentially rare, yet all components have identical entropy and full Lyapunov spectrum. This is a natural complete classification of coexisting components, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice; it applies at every n,k≥2 in the source's open Sk regime. Significance is restricted to the invariant core, not to generic perturbed basin selection.
